name: External Remote Services
summary: Adversaries may leverage external remote services as a point of initial access into your network. These services allow users to connect to internal network resources from external locations. Examples are VPNs, Citrix, and other access mechanisms. Remote service gateways often manage connections and credential authentication for these services. External remote services allow administration of a control system from outside the system. Often,…

analytics.name: Analytic 1935
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies authentication to an external remote access gateway using credentials associated with Industrial Control System (ICS)-role accounts, from a source geolocation or Autonomous System Number (ASN) inconsistent with the account's established usage pattern, immediately followed by that session establishing connectivity into the ICS network zone. Documented in VPNFilter, which specifically targeted routers and network edge devices. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another…

analytics.name: Analytic 2224
analytics.guidance: Near-real-time connection monitoring identifies connections to Industrial Control System (ICS) field device management ports from Internet Protocol (IP) addresses routed through external remote access infrastructure rather than from within the expected ICS network segments. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows. This analytic is implementable…

analytics.name: Analytic 2257
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an SSH authentication/session to an ICS Linux asset from a VPN-assigned or remote-access source outside the approved remote-administration baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

analytics.name: Analytic 2265
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS)-role account session originating from a Virtual Private Network (VPN)/remote access connection that subsequently accesses Windows ICS hosts in a pattern inconsistent with documented vendor support session profiles. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
